name: dark-pattern-exposer
description: 滚动叙事揭秘电商操控套路
interaction: As the user scrolls through a simulated e-commerce checkout flow, deceptive dark patterns—countdown timers, fake scarcity, hidden costs—visually peel apart layer by layer, revealing the manipulation mechanics beneath. Each scroll step dissects a specific dark pattern with annotated callouts, turning passive shopping habits into critical awareness through guided, story-driven exploration.
